remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600)

add_definitions(
    -D_WINE)

spec2def(winhttp.dll winhttp.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

add_typelib(winhttp_tlb.idl)

# winhttp.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/winhttp-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(winhttp_shims OBJECT cookie.c handle.c main.c net.c request.c session.c url.c)
target_link_libraries(winhttp_shims PRIVATE uuid wine libuser32 libadvapi32 libws2_32 libjsproxy libkernel32_vista libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(winhttp_shims)
add_dependencies(winhttp_shims stdole2)
add_cargo_module(winhttp winhttp-cargo winhttp.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS winhttp_shims psdk ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/winhttp_tlb.tlb uuid_sources)
